target: new: arrangement of member parts (flower PO_0009046 part of the inflorescence + crowded PATO_0000619; 'moderately' kept in the record)
reason: Says how closely the inflorescence's flowers are set, which is a quality of the flowers as members, not a count. Handled like 'densely flowered' in the 2026-11-14 review, with the degree word kept in RDF.
A loose comparison of a nectary to a molar tooth, found in one group only. Its shape meaning is too vague for a term.

target: not multi-colored (PATO_0001533)
reason: Variegated is a synonym of PATO_0001533 multi-colored, and 'not variegate' is its negation. It is not concolorous, which compares the two leaf surfaces.

target: new: two values of one bearer (asymmetrical PATO_0000616 + gibbous FLOPO:0991130)
reason: In floras, 'oblique' fruit means unequal-sided. The compound combines that with swollen on one side, so it is two values of one fruit.

target: prickle (PO_0025169) present
reason: Aculeate means bearing prickles, so a prickle is present. 'Obscurely' says how visible they are and stays in the record as a qualifier.

target: docs/odp/09-relation-to-another-part.md (perpendicular to PATO_0002434 towards leaf midvein PO_0020139)
reason: A relational orientation with its second term given (the leaf axis, i.e. the midrib). It takes 'towards', like the other relations.

target: new: colour of a pattern element (banded PATO_0001946 'striped', stripe colour pink PATO_0000954 as a colour tinge)
reason: Combines a colour pattern (stripes) with the colour of the stripes. Two values in one phrase, so no new term.

target: flat (PATO_0000407)
reason: Planate means flat, in a plane, as opposed to involute margins or rolled blades.

target: docs/annotation-context-patterns.md (continuum between two values: raceme-like FLOPO:0991197 – panicle-like FLOPO:0991198)
reason: An inflorescence between a raceme and a panicle, i.e. a raceme with some branches. A continuum of two existing FLOPO values.

target: docs/annotation-context-patterns.md (slot 1: part of the bearer — corolla throat, value red PATO_0000322)
reason: The 'eye' is a coloured zone at the corolla throat. This is a colour of a region of the corolla, not a quality of the whole corolla.

target: docs/annotation-context-patterns.md (continuum between two values: circular PATO_0000411 'rounded' – angular PATO_0001977, approximate)
reason: A shape between rounded and slightly angular. 'Sub-' marks an approximate value, as in pattern 01.

target: docs/odp/10-ratio-to-another-part.md (equality of colour: midvein or wing towards the body of the scale or fruit)
reason: A comparison of colour with another part, given in the sentence. It belongs to the equality-to-another-part pattern, not to a term.

target: new: two values of one bearer (scarious FLOPO:0991047 + erose PATO_0001368; at the tip, slot 1)
reason: Two existing values of one part: thin and dry, and irregularly toothed at the tip or margin.

target: docs/annotation-context-patterns.md (slot 1: part of the bearer — plant organ base FLOPO_0985024 + increased thickness PATO_0000591)
reason: Says the base of the claw or tubercle is thick, which is a quality of the base. Like the earlier 'thick-walled' decisions.

target: docs/odp/02-bounded-measurement.md (length of the spore's surface projections, part of the bearer, upper bound)
reason: Not a quality word: it is a measurement ('less than ...') of spore ornamentation. It belongs to the bounded-measurement pattern.

target: docs/odp/09-relation-to-another-part.md (surrounding PATO_0001772 'enclosing' towards seed PO_0009010; 'tightly' in the record)
reason: A relation that needs the enclosed part, which is the seed in the examples. Where no second term is given it fails pattern 09's check, like 'covered'.

target: not angular (PATO_0001977)
reason: Unangled stems and perianth tubes have no angles. It negates angular (synonym angulate).

target: bearded (FLOPO:0991118)
reason: Long soft hairs gathered in tufts on the blade. This fits bearded, defined as long hairs confined to a tuft, line or zone.

target: docs/odp/01-approximate-value.md (non-deciduous (any body part) PATO_0001732, qualifier weakly)
reason: Persistent is PATO_0001732, as in the reviewed 'subpersistent' and Collenette rules. 'Weakly' is a degree qualifier that stays in RDF.

target: new: two values of one bearer (leaf margin PO_0020128: white PATO_0000323 + crustaceous FLOPO:0991170)
reason: Leaf margins with a white, lime-encrusted edge, as in Saxifraga. This is a colour and a crust on one region of the leaf. Two floras do not justify an 'encrusted' term.
PO has caudex only as a synonym of stem, so 'caudex absent' would say 'stem absent', which is false. An absence rule needs a caudex class first.
It denies a gland-like kind of auricle, not auricles in general. 'Not auriculate' would wrongly deny ordinary auricles, and PO has only the grass leaf sheath auricle.

target: not tuberous (FLOPO:0991109)
reason: Roots without tuber-like swellings are roots that are not tuberous.

target: new: two values of one bearer (apex acuminate PATO_0002228 + awn PO_0025349 present)
reason: An apex that tapers into an awn: a shape value plus the presence of an awn, both already covered by rules.

target: docs/odp/09-relation-to-another-part.md (adnate FLOPO:0991129 towards pericarp PO_0009084)
reason: Fusion to a part of another kind, with that part named. This is the same form as 'adnate to the petals'.

target: setose (PATO_0002289)
reason: Bearing bristles is setose. PO seta (PO_0030032) is the moss sporophyte stalk and must not be used here.

target: awn (PO_0025349) present
reason: A bract whose tip is drawn out into a bristle is aristate. PO awn has 'bristle' as a synonym, and aristate is already the awn-present rule.

target: docs/odp/06-specimen-condition.md
reason: Describes the state of the specimens seen, not the plant. It stays in the record and does not go into OWL.

target: grey (PATO_0000950)
reason: Ash-grey or turning greyish (Latin cinerescens), said of stems and internodes. Not canescent, which is grey from hairs.

target: new: two values of one bearer (base: cuneate PATO_0001955 + stipitate FLOPO:0991065)
reason: A base that narrows like a wedge into a short stalk: two existing values of the fruit base.
